title: Cavity probe open
fullDescription: Southbend oven detected open RTD. No heat.

title: Over temperature
fullDescription: Hi-limit tripped. Stuck contactor or runaway probe.

title: Ignition lockout
fullDescription: Lockout after spark trial. Check gas supply or ignitor.

title: Fan motor fault
fullDescription: Blower not running. Check motor and capacitor.

title: Communication fault
fullDescription: Bus error between display and main board.

title: Steam timeout (proofer)
shortDescription: Steam pan did not reach humidity.
fullDescription: Proofer/oven combo did not reach humidity setpoint within time. Check water supply.

title: Memory checksum
fullDescription: EEPROM error after surge. Default and reload.

title: Voltage fault
fullDescription: Brownout / loose lug. Have electrician inspect.
